ei.title: 자아 인식: 로봇이 스스로를 구별해야 하는 이유

fullPassage: People involved in the conception and engineering of robots designed to perceive and act know how fundamental is the ability to discriminate oneself from other entities in the environment. Without such an ability, no goal-oriented action would be possible. Imagine that you have to build a robot able to search for blocks scattered in a room in order to pile them. Even this simple task would require that your machine should be able to discriminate between stimulation that originates from its own machinery and stimulation that originates from the blocks in the environment. Suppose that you equip your robot with an artificial eye and an artificial arm to detect, grab, and pile the blocks. To be successful, your machine will have to have some built-in system enabling it to discriminate between the detection of a block and the detection of its own arm. If not, the robot might endlessly chase itself rather than the blocks. Your robot would engage in circular, self-centered acts that would drive it away from the target or external goal.

questions.passage: People involved in the conception and engineering of robots ①<u>designing</u> to perceive and act know how fundamental is the ability to discriminate oneself from other entities in the environment. Without such an ability, no goal-oriented action would be possible. Imagine that you have to build a robot able to search for blocks scattered in a room in order to pile them. Even this simple task would require that your machine should be able to discriminate between stimulation that originates from its own machinery and stimulation that originates from the blocks in the environment. Suppose that you equip your robot with an artificial eye and an artificial arm to ②<u>detect</u>, grab, and pile the blocks. To be successful, your machine will have to have some built-in system ③<u>enabling</u> it to discriminate between the detection of a block and the detection of its own arm. If not, the robot might endlessly chase ④<u>itself</u> rather than the blocks. Your robot would engage in circular, self-centered acts that would drive it away from the target or external goal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① designing → designed: 로봇이 '설계하는' 것이 아니라 '설계된' 것이므로 과거분사 designed가 맞습니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① designing → designed: robots designed to perceive(인식하도록 설계된). 로봇은 설계의 대상(수동). ← 정답
✅ ② detect: to detect(to부정사) 올바름.
✅ ③ enabling: 현재분사(능동) system enabling it 올바름.
✅ ④ itself: 재귀대명사(the robot = itself) 올바름.
det.tip: 과거분사(수동): robots designed to V = V하도록 설계된 로봇

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② originating → originates: that절의 동사이므로 현재분사가 아닌 동사원형(3인칭 단수) originates가 필요합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① scattered: 과거분사(수동) blocks scattered in a room 올바름.
❌ ② originating → originates: stimulation that originates에서 that은 주격 관계대명사, 동사 originates 필요. ← 정답
✅ ③ built-in: 형용사(내장된) some built-in system 올바름.
✅ ④ drive: would drive(조동사 + 동사원형) 올바름.
det.tip: 관계대명사 that + 동사: that originates(O) / that originating(X)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② what → that: 선행사 stimulation이 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 필요합니다. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 불가.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② complex → simple: 원문은 'Even this simple task'로, '복잡한'이 아니라 '단순한' 과제입니다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ toward → away from: 순환적 자기중심 행위는 목표로 '향하는' 것이 아니라 목표에서 '멀어지는' 것입니다.

det.tip: drive away from(~에서 멀어지게 하다) ↔ drive toward(~를 향해 가게 하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: discriminate(구별하다): 자체 기계에서 비롯되는 자극과 블록에서 비롯되는 자극을 '구별'.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ discriminate: 글의 핵심 동사. between A and B 구조.
❌ ① perceive: '인식하다'는 첫 문장에 쓰이나, between과 어울리지 않음.
❌ ② originate: '비롯되다'는 자극 원천 동사이지 구별 아님.
❌ ③ engage: '관여하다'는 마지막 문장 맥락이지 구별 아님.
det.tip: discriminate between A and B = A와 B를 구별하다

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 로봇에는 인공 눈과 인공 팔이 장착된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문: equip your robot with an artificial eye and an artificial arm.
❌ ② 자아 구별 능력이 없어도 목표 행동이 가능하다 → 불가능(no ~ would be possible).
❌ ③ 로봇은 블록에서 비롯되는 자극만 구별하면 된다 → 자체 기계 자극도 구별 필요.
❌ ④ 구별 실패 시 로봇은 블록을 효율적으로 쌓는다 → 자기 자신을 쫓게 됨.
det.tip: equip A with B = A에 B를 장착하다

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 내장 시스템 없이도 로봇은 블록을 성공적으로 탐지할 수 있다 → 내장 시스템이 필수.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 내장 시스템 없이도 블록 탐지 성공 가능: 원문은 'To be successful, will have to have some built-in system'이므로 필수. ← 정답(불일치)
❌ ① 로봇 설계자는 자아 구별 능력이 근본적임을 안다 → 일치.
❌ ② 블록 쌓기도 자체 자극과 외부 자극 구별 필요 → 일치.
❌ ④ 구별 실패 시 순환적 자기중심 행위에 빠진다 → 일치.
det.tip: 불일치 문제: 원문 내용과 반대되는 선지를 찾기

ch: 로봇 설계자들은 자아 구별 능력이 근본적으로 중요하다는 것을 안다.

questions.passage: People involved in the conception and engineering of robots designed to perceive and act know how fundamental is the ability to discriminate oneself from other entities in the environment. Without such an ability, no goal-oriented action would be possible. Imagine that you have to build a robot able to search for blocks scattered in a room in order to pile them. Even this simple task would require that your machine should be able to discriminate between stimulation that originates from its own machinery and stimulation that originates from the blocks in the environment. Suppose that you equip your robot with an artificial eye and an artificial arm to detect, grab, and pile the blocks. To be successful, your machine will have to have some built-in system enabling it to discriminate between the detection of a block and the detection of its own arm. If not, the robot might endlessly chase itself rather than the blocks. Your robot would engage in circular, self-centered acts that would drive it away from the target or external goal.
